stimulus.action: reduce authoritative ECMO FdO2 with sweep flow held nonzero and fixed

expected_behavior: post-oxygenator pO2 decreases monotonically as FdO2 is reduced
post-oxygenator oxygen saturation is derived from the same modeled outlet O2 state and remains coherent with post-oxygenator pO2
post-oxygenator pCO2 is materially unchanged by an FdO2-only change when sweep flow is fixed
solved blood/circuit flow is materially unchanged by an FdO2-only change
with authoritative native mixed-venous oxygen supplying the membrane inlet, coupled-patient PaO2 decreases directionally as FdO2 is reduced at fixed sweep and blood-side conditions
returning FdO2 to baseline in the same runtime restores the coupled-patient oxygenation result without changing patient-directed ECMO flow
restoration_model: return FdO2 to baseline and re-evaluate the immutable control state
restoration_scope: deterministic control re-evaluation; not a stateful gas-source fault recovery test
not_modeled: persistent blender or oxygen-source fault state
oxygen source depletion or wall-gas failure
gas-line disconnection clues beyond the resulting control state
patient-specific quantitative prediction of the magnitude or time course of FdO2-driven oxygenation change
differential upper-body/lower-body oxygenation or mixing-point migration (Phase 11 territory)
future_retest_conditions: a persistent FdO2/blender/oxygen-source fault mechanism is introduced
the ownership or derivation of native mixed-venous oxygen changes
device-specific oxygenator gas-transfer data replace the provisional transfer targets
Phase 11 introduces differential VA mixing and upper-body/lower-body oxygenation states
notes: FdO2 values are regression control settings, not a patient oxygenation prescription.
CBC08 isolates oxygen fraction from sweep flow: FdO2 controls modeled O2 transfer while fixed sweep preserves modeled CO2 clearance.
The post-oxygenator saturation and pO2 pair must describe one internally consistent modeled O2 state rather than two independent transfer approximations.
Phase 9a supplies authoritative native mixed-venous oxygen at the patient boundary; Phase 10b protects the resulting directional coupled-patient FdO2 response without adding a second oxygen solver.
Phase 10b validates direction, separation from hydraulics/CO2, and same-runtime reversibility only; exact patient or device magnitudes remain non-validated.
Phase 11 differential hypoxemia physiology remains explicitly outside this contract.

supported_directionally: lower oxygen fraction delivered to the membrane lung can lower post-oxygenator oxygenation
FdO2 oxygenation control is distinct from sweep-flow control of carbon-dioxide removal
an FdO2-only change is not a blood-side pump-speed or resistance command
once the simulator uses authoritative native mixed-venous inlet oxygen, lower modeled ECMO return oxygenation can directionally lower the mixed coupled-patient arterial oxygen state
model_consistency_only: post-oxygenator saturation is derived from the same modeled pO2 state
not_supported_as_quantitative_claims: canonical FdO2 probe values as neonatal prescriptions
exact post-oxygenator pO2 or saturation magnitudes as device-specific performance
strict real-world pCO2 equality for every FdO2-only change
exact coupled-patient PaO2 or saturation magnitude, time course, or bedside prediction
